query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('liberation-war-films-source-boundary-244','liberation-war-documentaries-source-boundary-245','liberation-war-memorials-source-boundary-246','liberation-war-past-questions-source-boundary-247','liberation-war-past-questions-source-boundary-248')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0244-0248:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 244 AND 248)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
